$comment: What a browser downloads for the client core and the React adapter, in KB gzip (Vite app mode, production, minified, dist/, without React and i18n).

Checked by packages/react/src/bundle-size.test.ts (roadmap E75). Limits are a ratchet: only ever lower them. A size more than 0.3 KB under its limit fails until the limit follows (BESPOKE_SIZE_BUDGET=update lowers it).
A ceiling (everything) is not ratcheted: the whole adapter may shift between chunks, but not grow more than 2 KB over its size when Wave 5c started.
stillLeaking: features in a scenario that does not use them. Wave 5c takes them out one by one, until every list is []. A new leak fails, and so does a listed one that is gone.

Raised once, in Wave 5c step 2 (E78, Max, 02.10.): core 18.7 → 19.7, emptyApp 23.0 → 24.0, minimalApp 26.6 → 27.6, blank-app 27.4 → 30.4, web-app 34.1 → 35.1 — the cost of splitting the navigator into modules (≈ +1.0 KB gzip: one more hop per access, less gzip sharing across modules). Step 4 takes the feature modules out of apps that do not use them. Otherwise E75 holds: limits only go down.

appsGzipKB is the marginal cost of core + adapter in the app's initial load (what the download loses without their bytes), since Wave 5c step 3 — not the attributed share, which grows with the number of modules (step 2: +2.96 KB attributed for +1.05 KB real). Set from the marginal sizes at a0057db: blank-app 24.44, web-app 33.79.

Raised once more, in Wave 5c step 3 (E79, Max, 02.10.): to the measured sizes + 0.1 — core 19.7 → 21.1, emptyApp 24.0 → 25.4, minimalApp 27.6 → 29.0, everything (ceiling) 35.9 → 36.4, blank-app 24.6 → 25.9, web-app 33.9 → 35.3 (marginal). The feature host (hooks, slots, history writer) while every feature is still attached by default. Cumulative temporary cost of E78 + E79: +2.4 KB gzip on core (18.58 after step 1 → 21.00) — to be recovered in step 4: EVERY step-4 commit must lower these limits, and there is no further raise without Max.

Wave 5c step 4 (one commit per feature): 4b queryState — core 21.1 → 20.8, emptyApp 25.4 → 25.1, minimalApp 29.0 → 28.6, blank-app 25.9 → 25.6. 4d remember — core 20.8 → 20.4, emptyApp 25.1 → 24.7, blank-app 25.6 → 25.2, web-app 35.3 → 35.1 (minimalApp keeps it: useForm remembers, statically). 4f actions (+ the pages' optimistic patches out of the core; in every app's router) — core 20.4 → 19.0, emptyApp 24.7 → 23.8, minimalApp 28.6 → 27.7, blank-app 25.2 → 24.3, web-app 35.1 → 34.2. everything stays at its ceiling (36.40): its gzip moves ±0.15 with the order of the modules in its one chunk, while its min shrank (109.4 → 109.2 KB). 4c liveValidation (loaded on a form's first use, E74 — a chunk of its own) — core 19.0 → 17.9, emptyApp 23.8 → 22.6, minimalApp 27.7 → 27.4, blank-app 24.3 → 23.2, web-app 34.2 → 34.1 (everything 36.40 → 36.28).

4dev (E80, Max, 02.10.: pulled forward instead of raising the everything ceiling): developer explanations only in development builds, production throws a code (packages/http/README.md, Error codes) — core 17.9 → 17.7, emptyApp 22.6 → 22.0, minimalApp 27.4 → 26.4, blank-app 23.2 → 22.2, web-app 34.1 → 32.4. everything 36.28 → 34.74 under its ceiling, which stays at 36.4: that headroom is what the step bought for 4g–4k and step 5.

4g prefetch (loaded with the first prefetch, E74 — a chunk of its own; hooks now run in the features' order, not the order they were attached) — core 17.7 → 17.2, web-app 32.4 → 32.3. emptyApp (21.82 → 21.94), minimalApp (26.29 → 26.37) and blank-app (22.06 → 22.08) keep their limits: they grew inside them, from what a lazy chunk costs, not from code — Vite's preload helper (the empty app's first import(); a real app has it for its pages anyway) and, with two lazy chunks, a third chunk for the modules both share (page, request, notify, feature: 2 initial chunks instead of 1). everything 34.74 → 34.95.

4h revalidateOnBack (resolveModulePages brings it, <BespokeApp> attaches it: every real app resolves its pages that way, so the apps keep it — blank-app 22.08, web-app 32.16) — core 17.2 → 17.0, emptyApp 22.0 → 21.9, minimalApp 26.4 → 26.3 (everything 34.95 → 34.99).

4j instant visits (loaded where an instant link renders, E74 — a chunk of its own; a visit before then goes without its placeholder) — core 17.0 → 16.6, emptyApp 21.9 → 21.6, minimalApp 26.3 → 26.1, blank-app 22.2 → 22.0, web-app 32.3 → 32.1 (everything 34.99 → 34.72). Done before 4i: the guard, taken out first, moved into another chunk of the web-app and made it +0.18 heavier (min −0.1 KB) — over its limit.

4i guard (static where a component guards: useBlocker, useForm/Form guard; a visit's own confirm is now the core's) — core 16.6 → 16.1, emptyApp 21.6 → 21.1, blank-app 22.0 → 21.5 (minimalApp keeps it: useForm guards). Raised (E81, Max, 02.10., until step 6 sets the chunk strategy): web-app 32.1 → 32.2 — the guard lands with state.ts in the web app's entry chunk beside react-dom instead of the shared framework chunk: +0.18 gzip at the same min (32.02 → 32.20). everything 34.76 → 34.79.

4k islands (attached where an island renders; the core keeps a small RegionOwner per entry on screen — entry, Back flag, signal, live regions — and the islands feature makes the regions on it) — core 16.1 → 14.4, emptyApp 21.1 → 19.4, minimalApp 26.1 → 24.4, blank-app 21.5 → 19.7, web-app 32.2 → 28.9 (its islands now come with the pages that show them, in their chunks). everything 34.79 → 34.87.
